summary: Physics-first spurious-gold detection. Three mandatory core tests (weight-in-water with propagated uncertainty, DSIP photo material scan, ring-pitch acoustic physics), transparent log-odds fusion, declared decision policy, 10-step officer verification trail. No uploaded media persisted.

decision_stack.density: Archimedes + CRC water table + JCGM 106 conformity; claim-blind best-match identification (karat optional)
decision_stack.photo: Deterministic classical CV: backdrop removal, stone detection (coloured + colourless), inclusion cross-check, composition mixture model; baselines calibrated from 104 genuine photos
decision_stack.sound: Ring-pitch vs band calibrated from genuine recordings (v=sqrt(E/rho)); 10/10 composites flagged on real data; SVM secondary
decision_stack.fusion: Log-odds evidence sum with reliability weights and blind-spot floors; hand-recomputable; XGBoost kept as opt-in baseline (FUSION_MODE=xgboost)
decision_stack.policy: data/decision_policy.json — bands, overrides, multi-test approval mandate (weight+photo+sound)
decision_stack.records: Benford first-digit monitor on branch logs; shown to officer only when alerting

known_issues: Streak model abstains (proxy-trained) pending DS-7 real touchstone photos
